subgroup: Lesson 2: Contour Lines, Texture and Construction
instructions: Draw a sausage form, consisting of two spheres connected by a consistent central tube. Draw a minor axis line through the sausage. Then, you can add a few contour ellipses, varying in degrees, or you can add contour lines instead. Finally, add an ellipse on the tip of the sausage. For detailed instructions, click here.
goal: Contour lines reinforce the illusion of three-dimensionality of a form and gives us a better understanding on how these forms exist in 3d space.
